usedFor: A new Zoho CRM deal opens a shareable Google Drive link to a file.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deals” in Zoho CRM, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new deal is when a proposal or contract link is wanted, with set access level.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens the file to anyone with the link, so choose Viewer.
